name: ifc_get_placement_context
description:
Read room geometry, boundary hosts, openings and known obstacles.

`space_id` is an IfcSpace GlobalId. The backend binds `ifc_file_path` to
the current project's IFC; standalone callers may use IFC_FILE_PATH.
Coordinates and geometry are model-world metres. Bounding boxes are
approximations, not room polygons or verified mounting surfaces. Inspect
missing_data before proposing coordinates; never infer absent obstacles.
This operation does not change the IFC or generate placements.

name: ifc_list_placed_devices
description:
Liệt kê thiết bị và đối tượng hiện có trong IFC để lập phương án bố trí.

Gọi trước khi đề xuất thiết bị mới để xem hiện trạng. Lọc theo quan hệ
chứa/tham chiếu không gian và cấu trúc tầng của IFC; không suy ra phòng
từ tọa độ hoặc bounding box. Kết quả có thể gồm nội thất và proxy.

Args:
    ifc_file_path: Đường dẫn đến file IFC cần đọc, bắt buộc.
    space_id: GlobalId của IfcSpace; None để không lọc theo phòng.
    storey_id: GlobalId của IfcBuildingStorey; None để không lọc theo tầng.
        Nếu truyền cả hai, một chuỗi quan hệ không gian phải thỏa cả hai.
    ifc_types: Danh sách tên lớp IFC cần lấy, gồm cả lớp con. None dùng
        DEFAULT_DEVICE_TYPES (các nhóm MEP, proxy và nội thất); [] trả [].

Returns:
    Danh sách sắp xếp theo element_id; mỗi phần tử gồm:
    - element_id: GlobalId của đối tượng IFC.
    - device_type: ObjectType, hoặc Name, hoặc tên lớp IFC; là thông tin
      gốc, chưa chắc là mã loại thiết bị được chuẩn hóa.
    - space_id: GlobalId phòng theo quan hệ IFC, hoặc None nếu không rõ.
    - position: {x, y, z} của gốc ObjectPlacement trong hệ tọa độ model,
      đơn vị mét; None nếu thiếu placement. Đây không phải tâm hình học.
    - properties: {ifc_type, name, property_sets} từ IFC.

Raises:
    ValueError: GlobalId phòng/tầng sai loại hoặc ifc_types chứa lớp không
        có trong schema IFC. Lỗi mở file hoặc đọc IFC có thể được truyền ra.

Lưu ý: nếu lọc theo phòng, đối tượng không có quan hệ phòng phù hợp sẽ
không xuất hiện; danh sách rỗng không chứng minh phòng không có thiết bị.

name: ifc_clash
description:
Read-only IfcMCP query on the current project's pinned IFC. STEP IDs are model-local; use GlobalIds for placements. Check one element for geometric clashes against other elements.

    Reports hard intersections and, optionally, violations of a required
    clearance. Returns the overall ``pass``, the ``scope`` actually used, a
    ``checks`` block in which each clash names the other ``element``, the
    clash ``type``, the ``distance`` and the two closest points ``p1``/``p2``,
    and a de-duplicated flat ``elements`` list of everything involved.
    Geometry is computed for every element in scope, so this is slow on large
    models; ``pass`` is ``None`` with an ``error`` when the element has no
    usable geometry.

    :param model: The IFC model.
    :param element: The element to check.
    :param clearance: Minimum required clearance distance; when given, also
        runs the clearance check alongside the intersection check.
    :param tolerance: Intersection tolerance in meters (default 0.002).
    :param scope: ``"storey"`` (default) checks only elements sharing the
        same spatial container; ``"all"`` checks every ``IfcElement``.
        ``"storey"`` falls back to ``"all"`` when the element has no spatial
        container.
    :return: Dict with clash results suitable for JSON serialization.

Note: this method takes a plain ``clearance: float`` rather than
``clearance: float | None`` — ``0.0`` (the default) means "skip the
clearance check", matching ``None`` in ``ifcquery.clash.clash()``.

element_id.description: IFC numeric STEP ID from this exact loaded model, not an IFC GlobalId.

Read-only IfcMCP query on the current project's pinned IFC. STEP IDs are model-local; use GlobalIds for placements. Return all geometric representation contexts and subcontexts.

    Returns the entity's direct ``attributes`` plus, where present,

    ``placement`` and ``geometry_summary``. Keys are omitted when the
    information is unavailable.

    :param model: The in-memory IFC model.
    :param element: The entity to inspect.

element_id.title: Element Id

name: ifc_materials
description:
Read-only IfcMCP query on the current project's pinned IFC. STEP IDs are model-local; use GlobalIds for placements. List the materials and material sets defined in the model.

    Returns a single list covering ``IfcMaterial`` (with its category),
    ``IfcMaterialLayerSet`` (each layer's name, thickness, material and
    ventilation flag), ``IfcMaterialConstituentSet`` (constituent names,
    materials and fractions) and ``IfcMaterialProfileSet`` (profile names and
    materials). Every entry carries the step ID of the material entity.

    :param model: The in-memory IFC model.
    :return: List of dicts covering IfcMaterial, IfcMaterialLayerSet,
        IfcMaterialConstituentSet, and IfcMaterialProfileSet entities.

name: ifc_relations
description:
Read-only IfcMCP query on the current project's pinned IFC. STEP IDs are model-local; use GlobalIds for placements. Show how an element relates to the rest of the model.

    By default returns a dict whose optional blocks are ``hierarchy`` (parent,
    container, aggregate, nest, filled void, voided element), ``children``
    (contained, parts, components, openings), ``type_relationship``,
    ``groups``, ``systems``, ``zones``, ``material``, ``referenced_structures``
    and ``connections`` (connected to/from, ports), plus a de-duplicated flat
    ``elements`` list of everything referenced. Blocks with nothing to report
    are omitted.

    :param model: The IFC model.
    :param element: The element to examine.
    :param traverse: Set to ``'up'`` to instead return the chain of ancestors
        from the element to ``IfcProject`` as a flat list. Any other value
        gives the default behaviour.

element_id.description: IFC numeric STEP ID from this exact loaded model, not an IFC GlobalId.
element_id.title: Element Id

name: ifc_schema
description:
Read-only IfcMCP query on the current project's pinned IFC. STEP IDs are model-local; use GlobalIds for placements. Look up the IFC documentation for an entity class.

    Returns the class ``description``, its ``predefined_types``, per-attribute
    documentation and a ``spec_url``, resolved against the model's schema
    version. Returns an ``error`` key for an unknown class.

    :param model: The in-memory IFC model, used only for its schema version.
    :param entity_type: IFC class name, for example ``'IfcWall'``.

name: ifc_select
description:
Read-only IfcMCP query on the current project's pinned IFC. STEP IDs are model-local; use GlobalIds for placements. Filter elements using ifcopenshell selector syntax and return matching element summaries.

    Examples:
    - ``IfcWall`` — all walls
    - ``IfcWall, IfcColumn`` — walls and columns
    - ``! IfcWall`` — everything except walls
    - ``IfcWall, Name = "My Wall"`` — walls with a specific name attribute
    - ``type = "Concrete Wall"`` — elements assigned that type product
    - ``material = "Concrete"`` — elements with that material

name: ifc_summary
description:
Read-only IfcMCP query on the current project's pinned IFC. STEP IDs are model-local; use GlobalIds for placements. Summarise the model: schema, entity counts and project info.

    Returns the ``schema`` version, ``total_entities``, and a ``project``
    block with the id, name and description of the first ``IfcProject``
    (omitted if the model has none). The count covers every entity in the
    file, not just physical elements.

    :param model: The in-memory IFC model.

name: ifc_tree
description:
Read-only IfcMCP query on the current project's pinned IFC. STEP IDs are model-local; use GlobalIds for placements. Return the spatial hierarchy of the model as a nested tree.

    Starts at ``IfcProject`` and descends through decomposition (site,
    building, storeys) and containment (the elements placed in each storey).
    Every node carries ``id``, ``type`` and ``name``; ``children`` holds
    decomposed sub-spaces and ``elements`` holds contained elements, and
    either key is omitted when empty. Returns a list when the file contains
    several projects, or an ``error`` key when it contains none.

    :param model: The in-memory IFC model.

name: ifc_validate
description:
Read-only IfcMCP query on the current project's pinned IFC. STEP IDs are model-local; use GlobalIds for placements. Validate the model against the IFC schema.

    Returns ``valid`` together with a list of ``issues``, each carrying a
    ``level`` and a ``message``. Worth running after a batch of edits and
    before writing the model back to disk.

    :param model: The in-memory IFC model.
    :param express_rules: Also evaluate the schema's EXPRESS rules. Catches
        more problems but is considerably slower (default ``False``).
